name: Beneficiary Certification Type 5 Code
definition: Specifies the type of certification required.

ACCI.name: Accredited Investor
ACCI.definition: The holder of the security has to irrevocably certify that it is an Accredited Investor as defined in US Securities and Exchange Commission Regulation D.

NCOM.name: Non Company
NCOM.definition: The holder of the security has to certify he is an Non-Company related person.

QIBB.name: QIB Certification
QIBB.definition: The holder of the security has to irrevocably certify that it is a Qualified Institutional Buyer as defined in US Securities and Exchange Commission Rule 144A.
